title: Monotonicity and annular conical estimate for one fixed cutoff (abstract measure)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (w : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (R Λ ε : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (I E a : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < Λ → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → μ (closedBall y R) < ⊤ → IntegrableOn H (closedBall y R) μ → (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ (p - n)) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall y R, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((p - n) / (4 * p) * Λ) → AEStronglyMeasurable w (μ.restrict (ball y R)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ball y R → 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ u → φ u = 0) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (1 + ε) * ρ < R → ∫ x, ((n : ℝ) * φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) + ‖x - y‖ / ρ * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) * (1 - w x)) ∂μ = -∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂μ) → (∀ t, I t = ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ) → (∀ t, E t = ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂μ) → (∀ t, a t = E t / t ^ (n + 1) / (1 + I t / t ^ n)) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → (1 + ε) * t < R → ContinuousAt a t ∧ |a t| ≤ 2 * ((p - n) / (4 * p)) * Λ / R * (t / R) ^ (-((n : ℝ) / p))) ∧ ∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → (1 + ε) * r < R → Real.exp (-∫ τ in (0)..s, a τ) * (1 + I s / s ^ n) ≤ Real.exp (-∫ τ in (0)..r, a τ) * (1 + I r / r ^ n) ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall y r \ ball y ((1 + ε) * s), ENNReal.ofReal (w x / ‖x - y‖ ^ n) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ / 2) * (Real.exp (-∫ τ in (0)..r, a τ) * (1 + I r / r ^ n) - Real.exp (-∫ τ in (0)..s, a τ) * (1 + I s / s ^ n)))
